sentences.text: Barcinosuchus was an extinct genus of carnivorous crocodile-like reptile.
This peirosaurid lived during the Aptian to Albian stages of the early Cretaceous in what is now Chubut Province, Argentina.
The species is known from a single holotype specimen — the specimen the species is based on — consisting of a skull, lower jaw, and postcranial bones.
Martín Leardi and Diego Pol named the genus and its type species, Barcinosuchus gradilis, in 2009.
Barcinosuchus belongs to the family Peirosauridae.
Barcinosuchus is classified as a reptile.
Barcinosuchus lived between 113.2 and 100.5 million years ago during the Albian stage.
